passage:
Subject: Confession, and a small plan

Pooja,

Kabir got picked to lead the client demo on Thursday. He has been here eight months. I've been here three years, and I felt the sting straight away, a hot little thing in my chest, and then I was short with him in stand-up. 😅 Not proud of that. I stayed up half the night sulking, then got bored of sulking and admitted it: he's faster than me with the data. So today I asked Kabir to walk me through his model, and I told our manager the layout idea for the demo was his. I also signed up for the modelling course I kept postponing. It still stings a little. Tell me if I'm overdoing the noble bit.

Irfan

qa.q: How long has Kabir been at the company?
qa.a: Kabir has been there eight months.

qa.q: Why was Irfan short with Kabir in stand-up?
qa.a: Irfan felt a sting of envy in the chest after Kabir was picked to lead the demo, and it came out as sharpness.

qa.q: What steps did Irfan take after admitting the envy?
qa.a: Irfan asked Kabir to explain the model, credited Kabir to the manager for the layout idea, and signed up for the course Irfan had been postponing.

qa.q: How might Kabir have felt about Irfan's short manner in stand-up?
qa.a: Kabir may have been confused or uneasy, not knowing the reason, and may have felt more welcome once Irfan asked to learn from the model.

grounding: A talented junior progresses faster; Irfan notices the envy, then shares credit, learns from the junior and keeps building own skills.
